name: Buckeye Big Cubes Ohio State 2024

organisers.name: The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State

information:
This competition will only feature larger NxN cubes and Megaminx. As a result, this competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead [Ohio State Fall 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioStateFall2024), or any of the many [other competitions happening in Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

Due to the nature of this competition, it is imperative that all competitors help out when they are assigned. Refusing to help may result in disqualification.
